core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mina corresponds to the Arabic form منى and is glossed in this record as “Intensive labor or struggle.” The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mina corresponds to the Arabic form منى (Arabic مِنَى (Minā)). Its core sense is mina; a place near mecca. Mina is Arabic مِنَى (Minā), the name of a place near Mecca associated with the pilgrimage, also used as a female given name. The source gloss 'Intensive labor or struggle' is unsupported and has been replaced with the documented identification.

persian.name: منی
persian.long_meaning: Mina (منی) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن منی، مکانی نزدیک مکه است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: मिना

pashto.name: منی
pashto.long_meaning: Mina (منی) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې منی، د مکې نږدې ځای ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: منى
